# PR 004 — Add an independent fast adaptation path

> Reconstructed on 2026-10-11. Historical evidence window: 2026-10-04 19:09–19:26 UTC.

**Branch:** `research/exp-04-independent-fast-path`  
**Base:** `main`  
**Tag:** `v0.4.0`

## Hypothesis

An independently parameterized fast distribution will improve recovery and seed stability because its gradients bypass the slow routing Jacobian.

## Result

Fast-only routing reached 0.6986 ± 0.0259 at K=32 but reduced clean accuracy to 0.7158. A clean-preserving learned mixture recovered less.

## Review decision

Merge as support for independent gradient access and as evidence of a stability–plasticity problem. Next make activation conditional on regime.
